scope.sampling_rule: All available recent material decision records, bounded by the configured five-record-per-profile maximum; completed profile sessions only when real session evidence exists.

findings.summary: The Part 3 decision to use externalizable append-only decision records is supported by the stated privacy, auditability and governance constraints.

The v0.21 Part 4 rationale correctly preserved capability uncertainty and reused existing prompt gates, but it misframed Deep Research as a separate profile rather than using the general Custom Prompt profile; the later explicit user correction demonstrates that the target abstraction was incomplete.
The v0.22 correction is consistent with the clarified requirement: Custom Prompt owns prompt construction while Deep Research and other plugins remain separately enabled capabilities.

Two historical records contain recorded hashes for mutable canonical files whose current bytes have legitimately changed, but neither record has a verified immutable commit/release anchor; historical identity is therefore weaker than the record format can support.
The v0.22 record uses an unstructured plan-part target string that the deterministic checker cannot resolve as a local artifact/fragment.
No completed profile-specific session contract/trace/artifact set is available in the sampled evidence, so actual profile performance cannot yet be scored without fabricating evidence.

proposals.summary: For future material release records, include immutable release identity (for example the release tag/version plus stable artifact/source hashes) so later audits can distinguish expected evolution from unverifiable historical drift.
proposals.validation: Create a future release record, advance the workspace, then confirm the audit can resolve the original release identity without relying on current mutable bytes.
proposals.rollback: Retain current optional hash/link behavior if the added release-anchor requirement creates circular or excessive release friction.

proposals.summary: Use resolvable structured plan-part links such as project_plan.json#<part-id> instead of prose targets when the linked source exists locally.
proposals.validation: Generate a synthetic/current record with a structured plan-part target and confirm quality_audit.py resolves the source path.
proposals.rollback: Allow prose-only other links when no stable local locator exists.

proposals.summary: Keep cadence manual/on-demand until enough completed profile-session evidence exists to measure audit value and recurrence; do not invent a time/session schedule yet.
proposals.validation: Revisit after multiple real profile-session audits provide observed volume, recurring findings and audit cost.
proposals.rollback: No rollback needed; manual invocation remains available.

limitations: Only three material decision records are available and all are from general_balanced.
No completed profile-performance session report was discovered, so profile-performance findings remain UNKNOWN.
Current-byte hash drift on historical mutable files is expected after later releases; the finding concerns missing immutable release anchoring, not corruption.
